## Pull request overview This PR re-enables exporting C#/.NET (Mono) projects to the Web platform by removing the prior hard-block and wiring in Mono WASM runtime integration, along with the required build/export tooling updates. **Changes:** - Allow Web exports from Mono-enabled editor builds and surface an “experimental” warning instead of a hard failure. - Add Web-specific .NET SDK/MSBuild targets and a helper project to locate/fetch the Mono WASM runtime pack. - Update Mono build scripts and Web platform detection to support the new Mono WASM workflow. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 10 out of 14 changed files in this pull request and generated 8 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | temp_managed_callbacks.cs | Adds unmanaged-callback stub declarations (currently appears redundant/unreferenced). | | platform/web/export/export_plugin.cpp | Removes the C# Web-export hard block and replaces it with an experimental warning. | | platform/web/detect.py | Adjusts web platform flags and architecture validation for Mono. | | modules/mono/runtime/GetRuntimePack/GetRuntimePack.csproj | New helper project to resolve the Mono runtime pack location for Web (browser-wasm). | | modules/mono/editor/GodotTools/GodotTools/Export/ExportPlugin.cs | Extends .NET export pipeline to handle wasm32 and Web-specific packaging behavior. | | modules/mono/editor/Godot.NET.Sdk/Godot.NET.Sdk/Sdk/Sdk.targets | Imports Browser-specific MSBuild targets when exporting to web. | | modules/mono/editor/Godot.NET.Sdk/Godot.NET.Sdk/Sdk/Sdk.props | Imports Browser-specific MSBuild props when exporting to web. | | modules/mono/editor/Godot.NET.Sdk/Godot.NET.Sdk/Sdk/Browser.targets | New Browser MSBuild targets to configure Mono WASM runtime settings and trimming roots. | | modules/mono/editor/Godot.NET.Sdk/Godot.NET.Sdk/Sdk/Browser.props | New (currently empty) Browser props file. | | modules/mono/build_scripts/mono_configure.py | Adds Web platform Mono WASM runtime pack retrieval + static linking setup. |
Comments suppressed due to low confidence (3) **modules/mono/runtime/GetRuntimePack/GetRuntimePack.csproj:54** * Same issue as above: `` should use `Text=...` rather than `Message=...` for consistent behavior across MSBuild versions. ``` ``` **modules/mono/editor/GodotTools/GodotTools/Export/ExportPlugin.cs:237** * If `PublishConfig.Archs` remains a `HashSet`, the iOS simulator config should also use a `HashSet` initializer so the code compiles and keeps de-duplication behavior consistent. ``` targets.Add(new PublishConfig { BuildConfig = publishConfig.BuildConfig, Archs = new List { "arm64", "x86_64" }, BundleOutputs = false, IncludeDebugSymbols = publishConfig.IncludeDebugSymbols, RidOS = OS.DotNetOS.iOSSimulator, ``` **modules/mono/editor/GodotTools/GodotTools/Export/ExportPlugin.cs:570** * Changing `PublishConfig.Archs` to `List` changes behavior (duplicates allowed) and can lead to redundant publish operations. Consider keeping it as `HashSet` for set semantics, even if you avoid C# collection-expression syntax. ``` public bool UseTempDir; public bool BundleOutputs; public string RidOS; public List Archs; public string BuildConfig; public bool IncludeDebugSymbols; } ```
